T. rigs lnga; S. panca-gotra or pancakula. 'Mystic' family or conclave as contrasted to the mythological families. The system which became important in 'esoteric' Bsm. (Lamaism) is an attempt of putting order into mythological chaos with regard to cosmology, macro- and microcosmos, soteriology, anatomy, in brief almost everything which could be subsumed under a pentad. They are: Masi geigylegci; T. Rnam par snang mdzad; S.Vairocana (center); Købdylesi ygei; T. Mi hkhrugs pa; S. Akshobhya (east); Erdeni γarxu jin orun; T. Rin chen hbyung gnas; S. Ratna- sambhava (south); Caγlasi ygei gerelty; T. Hod dpag med; S. Amitabha (west); Byky tusa ji bytygegci; T. Don yod grub pa; S. Amogha-siddhi (north). These Bus. are also called: 'Buddhas of transcendent awareness' . See burxan.
